coordinate_calibration.provenance: Physical scan window reconstructed from the stored PSV camera frame of SP02_500by500_Glue420_honeycomb_full_scan_retry_260803.svd (registration_evidence/SP02_physical_registration_reconstruction.json, sha256 b9234f573b6ab98acad4944ff4a2786ac16baab2e29d41c061d55aec5900707e): PSV MeasPoints video coordinates validated against the UNV geometry, panel edges fitted in the frame with the SP-13 method unchanged, physical scale from the panel dimensions 510 x 515 mm (spec 515 x 510 x 2.9; horizontal 510 from the frame aspect and the FE X extent). The UNV metric coordinates are anisotropic (x 1.092, y 0.818 of physical); this per-axis camera-grid scale replaces them. No modal data or MAC were used.

measured_surface.label: labelled exterior face measured by the scanner (handwritten label visible in the stored frame); bound to FE TOP by the accepted SP-02 convention: the face sign is not demonstrable from records (FE stack is through-thickness symmetric)

orientation.source: panel edges fitted in the stored PSV frame (reconstruction record above); unnumbered handwritten label '500x500 / Plain fiber / honey comb / DP420' at the top right of the measured face in the stored frame; the 510 mm side is horizontal (frame aspect, FE X extent 510). FE in-plane axis signs are not determinable from records (no SP-02 counterpart of HUMAN H7): the nominal +x->+X, +y->+Y continues the accepted SP-02 documented convention and was fixed before any pairing evaluation; the 180 deg alternative is reported in the evidence, never selected
